evd_title: 57.4% of 308 researchers found GPT-4 feedback helpful and 82.4% found it more beneficial than at least some human reviewers
finding: 57.4% of 308 researchers found GPT-4 feedback helpful and 82.4% found it more beneficial than at least some human reviewers
P: 308 researchers from 110 US institutions (AI/CS, computational biology), each uploading own paper posted after Sep 2021
I: GPT-4 single-pass prompt over parsed PDF (~6,500 tokens), 4-section structured feedback
O: 5-pt Likert: 82.4% rated GPT-4 more beneficial than >= some human reviewers; 57.4% helpful/very helpful; 17.5% inferior to most
T: Recruited arXiv authors of Jan-Mar 2023 preprints; papers post-Sep 2021 (paper 2024)
